# [TASK] Review and clear the open Dependabot PR backlog

## Task
Epic #76 has no open child Story right now (#77 and #113 are both closed), and Dependabot PRs keep accumulating without a Housekeeping Task tracking them, contrary to #77's established convention ("a Dependabot PR... merge commit references a real Housekeeping Task"). This Task is that tracking point, and records what autonomous runs found and could/couldn't act on within their scope discipline (no CI/CD workflow edits; no dependency bumps without an issue authorizing them).

## Parent Story
(none — pure maintenance/triage work, no open Story exists to parent it under; see Epic #76)

## Findings

**Closed as stale (2026-08-20 run):** #167, #169 — both targeted `/frontend/filmpire`, a path that no longer exists on `develop`/`main` (frontend was consolidated to `/frontend/lmdb`).

**`/frontend/lmdb` npm bumps — round 1 (2026-08-21 run):**
- #172 (`@testing-library/user-event` 14.6.3→14.6.4): merged into `main` (`4714da9`).
- #170 (`@testing-library/jest-dom` 7.0.0→7.0.1): merged into `main` (`e262196`) after tracing an apparent Vercel failure to unrelated test additions, not the bump.
- #171 (dev-dependencies group: `eslint` 8→10, `eslint-plugin-react-hooks` 4→7, babel eslint tooling 7→8): **real regression** — `eslint-config-airbnb@19.0.4` requires `eslint` ^7 || ^8, incompatible with `eslint@10.8.1`. Closed with reasoning.

**`/frontend/lmdb` npm + gradle-wrapper bumps — round 2 (this run, 2026-08-27):** 8 new PRs had accumulated since round 1 (#178-185).
- #180 (`vitest` 4.1.10→4.1.11), #181 (`@vitest/coverage-v8` 4.1.10→4.1.11), #182 (`web-vitals` 6.1.0→6.1.1), #183 (`@testing-library/user-event` 14.6.4→14.6.5): green Vercel previews. Verified locally together — `npm ci` clean, `npm run build` succeeds, full `vitest` suite 212/212 passing, lint clean. **Merged** into `main` individually (`8056cd9`, `1b7acb`, `4644a29`, `06c7a5c`).
- #184 (`@vitejs/plugin-react` 6.0.5→6.1.0), #185 (`vite` 8.2.1→8.2.2): also verified clean locally, but by the time they were ready to land, #180-183 had already merged and moved `main` far enough (same `devDependencies` block, adjacent lines) that GitHub reported real merge conflicts on both. Carried both bumps forward manually in one commit (`75d0ef6`) on `main`, re-verified (`npm ci`/build/212 tests/lint all clean) before pushing. **Closed as superseded** by `75d0ef6`.
- #178 (`gradle-wrapper` 9.7.0→9.7.1): patch release, wrapper jar + `distributionUrl` only. Verified `./gradlew --version` bootstraps 9.7.1 cleanly. **Merged** into `main` (`9642d10`).
- #179 (dev-dependencies group, same shape as #171: `eslint` 8→10, `eslint-plugin-react-hooks` 4→7, babel eslint tooling 7→8): Dependabot recreated the same real regression already found on #171. Reproduced the identical `eslint-config-airbnb` peer-dependency conflict locally. **Closed** with reasoning, same as #171.

**GitHub Actions bumps — still out of autonomous scope:** #163 (`actions/checkout` 4→7), #164 (`actions/setup-java` 4→5), #165 (`actions/setup-node` 4→7), #166 (`actions/setup-python` 5→7), #168 (`actions/cache` 4→6). These edit `.github/workflows/*.yml`, which CLAUDE.md's scope discipline explicitly puts off-limits for autonomous runs ("Don't edit CI/CD workflows"). Still need a human to review and merge directly. Re-checked this run: all 5 are still open, unchanged since 2026-08-13.

## Scope
No dependency versions were bumped by this Task itself beyond merging/carrying-forward Dependabot's own proposed bumps after local verification — no new upgrades were introduced. #163-166/#168 remain for human review per the CI/CD-edit restriction; this Task stays open until those are handled. The recurring `eslint-config-airbnb` conflict (#171, #179) needs a human-scoped decision (replace or upgrade the config) before Dependabot's dev-dependencies group PR can ever land automatically — also out of this Task's scope, noted here so it isn't re-investigated from scratch every recurrence.
